question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Estimate
solution:
The correct answer is **Evaluate)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Estimate"** means to roughly calculate or judge the value, number, quantity, or extent of something. (अनुमान लगाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The engineer had to **estimate **the cost of the new project before it could be approved.
 
 
 
• **"Evaluate" **refers to the process of assessing or appraising something to determine its value, quality, or importance. (मूल्यांकन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher will **evaluate **the students' essays based on their content and clarity.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Estimate' **is **'Evaluate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Profit **(लाभ): The financial gain made in a transaction.

 
 
• **Example:** The company made a significant **profit** in the last quarter.
 
 
 
• **Appropriate **(उचित): Suitable or proper in the circumstances.
 
 
• **Example: **It is **appropriate **to wear formal attire to the wedding.
 
 
 
• **Verify** (सत्यापित करना): Make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist had to **verify** the results of the experiment before publishing them.
